stdout:
List playlist items. Use this tool to list playlist items.

Usage:
  yutu playlistItem list [flags]

Examples:
# List items in a playlist
yutu playlistItem list --playlistId PLxxx
# List playlist items with limit in JSON format
yutu playlistItem list --playlistId PLxxx --maxResults 20 --output json
# List specific playlist items by IDs
yutu playlistItem list --ids abc123,def456

Flags:
  -h, --help                            help for list
  -i, --ids strings                     IDs of the playlist items to list
  -n, --maxResults int                  The maximum number of items that should be returned, 0 for no limit (default 5)
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string   ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -o, --output string                   json|yaml|table (default "table")
  -p, --parts strings                   Comma separated parts (default [id,snippet,status])
  -y, --playlistId string               Return the playlist items within the given playlist
  -v, --videoId string                  Return the playlist items associated with the given video id
